title: Recognition and removal of clustered DNA lesions via nucleotide excision repair.
authors: Naumenko, N V; Petruseva, I O; Lomzov, A A; Lavrik, O I
one_liner_zh: 该文研究哺乳动物核苷酸切除修复系统对成簇DNA损伤的识别与去除，结合分子动力学模拟分析损伤簇引起的DNA结构变化，属于广义蛋白质-DNA互作（修复蛋白与损伤DNA）且含物理模拟方法，但非TF-DNA体系，故评6分。
abstract: Clustered damage of DNA consists of two or more lesions located within one or two turns of the DNA helix. Clusters consisting of lesions of various structures can arise under the influence of strong damaging factors, especially if the cells have a compromised repair status. In this work, we analyzed how the presence of an analog of the apurinic/apyrimidinic site - a non-nucleoside residue consisting of diethylene glycol phosphodiester (DEG) - affects the recognition and removal of a bulky lesion (a non-nucleoside site of the modified DNA strand containing a fluorescein residue, nFlu) from DNA by a mammalian nucleotide excision repair system. Here we demonstrated that the efficiency of nFlu removal decreases in the presence of DEG in the complementary strand and is completely suppressed when the DEG is located opposite the nFlu. By contrast, protein factor XPC-RAD23B, which initiates global genomic nucleotide excision repair, has higher affinity for DNA containing clustered damage as compared to DNA containing a single bulky lesion; the affinity of XPC strengthens as the positions of DEG and nFlu become closer. The changes in the double-stranded DNA's geometry caused by the presence of clustered damage were also assessed. The obtained experimental data together with the results of molecular dynamics simulations make it possible to get insight into the structural features of DNA containing clustered lesions that determine the efficiency of repair. Speaking more broadly, this study should help to understand the probable fate of bulky adduct-containing clusters of various topologies in the mammalian cell.
abstract_zh: DNA的簇损伤由位于DNA螺旋一圈或两圈内的两个或多个损伤位点组成。由不同结构损伤组成的簇可在强损伤因素作用下产生，尤其是在细胞修复状态受损的情况下。在本工作中，我们分析了无嘌呤/无嘧啶位点类似物——一种由二乙二醇磷酸二酯（DEG）组成的非核苷残基——的存在如何影响哺乳动物核苷酸切除修复系统对DNA中一个庞大损伤（含有荧光素残基的修饰DNA链的非核苷位点，nFlu）的识别和去除。我们证明，当互补链中存在DEG时，nFlu的去除效率降低，而当DEG位于nFlu对面时，去除完全被抑制。相反，启动全局基因组核苷酸切除修复的蛋白因子XPC-RAD23B对含有簇损伤的DNA比含有单一庞大损伤的DNA具有更高的亲和力；随着DEG和nFlu位置靠近，XPC的亲和力增强。还评估了簇损伤存在引起的双链DNA几何结构变化。获得的实验数据连同分子动力学模拟结果，使我们能够深入了解含有簇损伤的DNA的结构特征，这些特征决定了修复效率。更广泛地说，这项研究应有助于理解哺乳动物细胞中不同拓扑结构的含庞大加合物簇的可能命运。
